topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I heard the news as the waiter brought out my last meal here, the same dish I've ordered every visit, like a lullaby only this place could sing. The evening seems a little dimmer, shadows gathering where once there was light. But instead of sorrow, I think of all the times the wooden floor creaked with laughter, how the old paintings on the walls seemed to watch with mild amusement, the same as when they saw me first step through the door. I'll take these moments, wrap them like a scarf around me, and carry them forward. Maybe, just maybe, there’s a new place waiting, eager to start its own story with me.
